nom: TATCHA The Dewy Skin Cream Line-Plumping Moisturizer

segments.oily: Several reviewers with combination or oily-prone skin found the cream sits on top of skin, feels greasy, or is too heavy, and one warns it may not suit oily or acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry, very dry, or flaking/peeling skin report strong, lasting hydration and describe it as their holy grail, though a couple with dry skin still found it greasy and non-absorbing or ineffective.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split, with one describing it as thin and effective for mixed dry/oily areas and another reporting it ruined her skin with breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation or burning and good results, including one with rosacea-prone dry skin who found it the only product that helped.
segments.mature: Mature and perimenopausal/postmenopausal reviewers consistently praise it for plumping, smoothing fine lines, and giving a glow, especially in dry winter months.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or dry-to-normal skin report it absorbs well and keeps skin soft and fresh throughout the day.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against aging report plumping and smoothing of fine lines and wrinkles, with several mature-skin users noting visible firmness and glow.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority report significant, lasting hydration and relief from dry, flaking, or tight skin, though a few say it sat on top of skin without truly moisturizing it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it keeps her skin calm and redness-free over a full day; another with rosacea reports it is the only product that helped her dryness.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user credits it with healing her skin barrier, and a tret user reports it relieves the tight, dry feeling caused by retinoid use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne scars found the texture pleasant but had not yet seen improvement in scarring after a short trial.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts, including one who specifically praises it for never breaking her out, but three reviewers with combination or dry skin report new acne, blackheads, or cystic-like welts after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination dry/oily skin found the thinner formula worked well without excess oiliness, while others warn the cream feels oily or too heavy, particularly for oily or acne-prone skin.

aspects.libelle: Slow or no absorption, sits on skin
Small quantity lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Ruined my skin. Don't buy this
extraits.texte: I have combo skin, ive never had a problem with acne but this prodcut caused it. I had horrible black heads and pimples from this. It completely RUINED my skin, i have scars everywhere. I teally wanted to like this product.

I was so excited for this, especially bc i have such dry skin & the reviews were amazing. I've used most of it so i feel justified in leaving a review, although im not sure where to start. This did nothing for my dry skin. It gave me a moisturized, greasy look, but mostly sat on top of my skin while doing nothing to heal it. Secondly, ive had the worst breakouts of my life while using this product. I thought sticking it out would be worth it, but no. This also does not work well with make up. It basically peeled right off my face, no matter how little i used. I could cry knowing i spent $100 just to look the worst i have in years. I still have dry skin, now its just covered in acne, and my make up looks awful. I wont be using this again. While im glad others seem to have good luck with it, its not for me. At all.

Love love love this product! I bought the smallest travel size on a whim to try out. This product moisturized my face so well without being greasy or breaking me out. I have very dry, sensitive, acne prone skin. I went ahead and ordered the bigger version because this will now be a staple in my routine!

This is life. I have dry skin and this is my holy grail! I've tried to get dupes because the price tag on this is STEEP but there is nothing like this!! I love that it makes my skin look AND feel dewy. I would not recommend this for people who do not like the "greasy" after feel because this does leave a slight layer on your skin. For me that is everything because I always feel dried up.

extraits.titre: LOVE!! If you're a rosacea and dry skin girly
extraits.texte: I love this moisturizer so much. I use it for night time and its super hydrating and i even wake up with my face still hydrated. I suffered from reslly dry skin and nothing seemed to help. Ive tried cerave, vanicream and nothing helped but this! I recommend trying the $25 small travel size one and if you love it like me, purchase the big one! You wont regret it.

extraits.titre: Finally a moisturizing cream throughout the winter
extraits.texte: I used to buy name brands at department stores that cost hundreds for an ounce of cream that could not achieve the dry winter months as well as the Dewy cream. It may be greasy for many younger women but perfect for those in their 50's post menopause.

I dont know why I've ever been unfaithful to tatcha but it stops now. This moisturizer is my HOLY GRAIL. I have purchased this product over 10 times and Ive never been one to leave reviews but this product deserves it. It is pricey, I know. I too let this factor deter me from purchasing it regularly but every single time i stray to save money, I regret it immediately. This product has healed my skin barrier and I am finally convinced that i can no longer live without it. I will die on this hill. That is all.
